content.title: 'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: After almost six months, the second part of "Beauty in Black" Season 2 arrived on Netflix.The Tyler Perry helmed show follows the controversial family behind a beauty brand, "Beauty in Black" follows former sex worker, Kimmie, who is now calling the shots after inheriting ownership of the family business.All eight episodes of the concluding chapter are now available to stream, continuing the story where it left off in September 2025. Beauty In Black. (L to R) Charles Malik Whitfield as Jules, Taylor Polidore Williams as Kimmie, Crystle Stewart as Mallory in episode 212 of Beauty In... | Cr. Quantrell Colbert/Netflix'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Release Date"Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will be available to stream on Netflix on March 19, 2026.All episodes of "Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will land on Netflix at once.Will All Episodes of 'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Be Released at Once?Yes. All eight episodes of "Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will be available to stream on Netflix from March 19.'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 – How to Watch"Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will be available on Netflix from 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on March 19, 2026.A Netflix subscription is required to stream Season 2 Part 2 of "Beauty in Black". A standard subscription with ads is $7.99 per month, and a standard no-ads subscription starts at $17.99 per month.What Time Does 'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Come Out?"Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will debut on Netflix on March 19 at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET.Here is when "Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will be available to stream in different time zones:BRT: 4:00 amBST: 8:00 amCEST: 9:00 amIST: 12:30 pmJST: 4:00 pmAET: 5:00 pmNZDT: 7:00 pm'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Release ScheduleAll eight episodes of "Beauty in Black" Season 2 Part 2 will be released on March 19.What Will Happen in 'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2?The official synopsis for season two of "Beauty in Black" reads: "The ruthless, backstabbing family behind a beauty brand — and an underground trafficking ring — will face a reckoning. Kimmie, the once-unassuming sex worker in their employ, becomes an unstoppable force and is now the one calling the shots after inheriting sole ownership of the family business."How Many Episodes Will 'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Have?Part 2 of Season 2 of Beauty in Black will have eight episodes.'Beauty in Black' Season 2 Part 2 Episode TitlesEpisode 1: Blind RageEpisode 2: Power StruggleEpisode 3: Up Against the WallEpisode 4: Hot SeatEpisode 5: By Any MeansEpisode 6: Wild RideEpisode 7: The Lion's DenEpisode 8: Now Make It Thunder(as per Netflix)Will There Be a Season 3 of ‘Beauty in Black’?Yes, a third season of "Beauty in Black" has been confirmed.When Will Season 3 of 'Beauty in Black' Be Released?A release date for Season 3 of "Beauty in Black" is yet to be confirmed.
